summary: Bahrain's Interior Ministry reported that a civilian industrial facility was hit in what it called an Iranian attack, causing a fire and property damage but no casualties, after sirens and explosions were reported across the country. CENTCOM denied Iran's claim that its air defenses damaged an American F-16 over the Gulf and confirmed an expansion of its Iran blockade enforcement to ship-to-ship transfers. In Lebanon, the daily alert count reached 160, driven by 88 UAV sightings and 29 artillery alerts, concentrated in the Bint Jbeil, Tyre and Nabatieh districts.
key_points: Bahrain's Interior Ministry said a civilian industrial facility was hit in an Iranian attack, sparking a fire with only property damage and no casualties reported (Source: @yediotnews25/138286).
CENTCOM denied Iran's claim that its air defenses damaged an American F-16 over the Gulf, saying all US fighter aircraft in the Middle East are accounted for (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10314).

CENTCOM expanded Iran blockade enforcement on November 18, warning that vessels receiving Iranian cargo via ship-to-ship transfers may be stopped, boarded, diverted or seized (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10312).
Lebanon recorded 160 alerts on Saturday, including 88 UAV sightings and 29 artillery alerts, concentrated in Zawtar al-Sharqiya, Braashit and Haddatha (Source: @redlinkleb/54407).
Missiles were launched from Ahvaz in Khuzestan and Meymeh in Isfahan province, and a UAV took off from the Fifth Base at Omidiyeh, Khuzestan (Source: @shin_persian/12700).
Houthi forces advanced to within 80km north and 110km west of Aden, with government forces reinforcing checkpoints and digging defensive positions (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10308).
At least four focal points of settler riots and arson were reported in Palestinian villages in the Ramallah area and southern Mount Hebron, with no arrests known (Source: @yediotnews25/138290).
The IDF announced a large drill dubbed 'Shield and Storm' in southern Israel beginning Sunday, simulating scenarios including infiltration of Israeli territory (Source: @manniefabian/59567).

CENTCOM denied Iran's claim that its air defenses damaged an American F-16 over the Gulf and confirmed an expansion of its Iran blockade enforcement to ship-to-ship transfers. points: Iranian missile and UAV launches were recorded across multiple provinces: a missile was fired from Ahvaz, Khuzestan at 22:47 local time (1917Z), two missiles were launched from Meymeh in Isfahan province, and a UAV took off from the Fifth Base at Omidiyeh, Khuzestan. All three reports were relayed with a 120-second delay via FromIran. (Source: @shin_persian/12700) (Source: @shin_persian/12709) (Source: @shin_persian/12708)

Additional air activity was reported over western and southwestern Iran: UAV activity over Urmia in West Azerbaijan province at 00:19 local time (2049Z), and the sound of UAVs accompanied by intense air-defense activity in Ramhormoz, Khuzestan province. Both reports were delayed 120 seconds via FromIran. (Source: @shin_persian/12711) (Source: @shin_persian/12712)

Blasts were heard again in the Strait of Hormuz, according to a delayed FromIran report, indicating continued explosive activity in the strategic waterway. The message provided no further detail on the source of the explosions, casualties, or damage. (Source: @shin_persian/12698)

CENTCOM denied Iran's claim that its air defenses damaged an American F-16 over the Gulf the previous evening or forced an emergency landing. According to CENTCOM, Iran did not attack an F-16 at all, and all US fighter aircraft in the Middle East are accounted for. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10314)

CENTCOM expanded its Iran blockade enforcement on November 18, warning that vessels receiving Iranian cargo through ship-to-ship transfers may be stopped, boarded, diverted or seized even without entering Iranian ports. The measure extends interdiction beyond Iranian territorial waters to transshipment activity. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10312)

A post about an Iranian tanker conducting a ship-to-ship transfer while approaching the US blockade was removed as a spoof; TankerTrackers.com said the tanker does not exist and that the AIS data was wrong with no satellite corroboration. The Iranian threat to attempt such a transfer, and the repercussions of targeting such a vessel, remain standing statements. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10317)

More than 20 Nopo motorcycles were reported moving through Kianpars in Ahvaz with sirens on, a domestic security movement in Khuzestan's provincial capital recorded alongside missile and UAV launches from the same province. (Source: @shin_persian/12701)

The IDF announced a large military drill in southern Israel over the coming days, dubbed 'Shield and Storm' and led by the Southern Command, beginning Sunday. The exercise will simulate several scenarios including infiltration of Israeli territory, with the army warning of increased movement of security forces and naval vessels in the area. (Source: @manniefabian/59567)

Israeli fighter jets were reported heading toward southern Lebanon in three separate alerts issued by the Lebanese live-map channel, alongside continued artillery fire and machine-gun sweeping in the same border area. (Source: @redlinkleb/54364) (Source: @redlinkleb/54362) (Source: @redlinkleb/54359)

The IDF condemned the nationalist crime events overnight in Judea and Samaria, stating that they harm public order, divert attention, undermine stability and also damage the operational and counter-terrorism activity of IDF forces. (Source: @N12chat/236268)

Yashar party chairman MK Gadi Eisenkot said the night of arson in Judea and Samaria is 'Jewish terror' in every sense, that extremist groups torching vehicles and homes undermine regional stability, endanger lives and severely damage Israel's national security and foreign relations, and called for administrative detentions and targeted Shin Bet activity against the rioters. (Source: @yediotnews25/138296)

A Turkish citizen who arrived in Israel as part of an organized tourist group was arrested at the end of the week on suspicion of distributing money to worshippers at the Temple Mount; police also suspect her of incitement. (Source: @N12chat/236264)

The Israeli military said it carried out a strike on three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza City earlier in the day, who were falsely presented as aid workers. The strike in the Tel al-Hawa neighborhood killed three, according to Palestinian media. (Source: @manniefabian/59569)

Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin met Hamas political leader Khalil al-Hayya and a senior delegation in Istanbul to discuss the situation in Gaza, Turkish security sources told Anadolu. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10313)

During the night, five focal points of nationalist crime were reported in Judea and Samaria following riots by Jewish settlers in Palestinian villages in the Ramallah area and southern Mount Hebron. (Source: @N12chat/236255)

A series of riots and arson incidents hit Palestinian villages in Judea and Samaria overnight, at least four focal points in the Ramallah area and southern Mount Hebron. Arson and attempted arson of vehicles and property were reported along with graffiti including the word 'revenge'; no arrests were known. (Source: @yediotnews25/138290)

Yashar party chairman MK Gadi Eisenkot said the arson night in Judea and Samaria is 'Jewish terror' in every sense, that torching vehicles and homes endangers lives and damages Israel's national security and foreign relations, and demanded the government and defense establishment use all tools including administrative detentions and targeted Shin Bet activity. (Source: @N12chat/236269)

The end-of-day report for Saturday, November 21, 2026 recorded 160 total alerts, led by 88 UAV sightings followed by 29 artillery alerts. Alerts concentrated in Zawtar al-Sharqiya (11), Braashit (10) and Haddatha (8); at district level Bint Jbeil recorded 30, Nabatieh 29 and Tyre 28, with 84 in Nabatieh governorate. The count rose 14 alerts (10%) over the previous day's 146. (Source: @redlinkleb/54407)

The same report put the week's total at 726 alerts, an 11% decrease from the same days last week, while the November total reached 2,545 alerts, a 24% increase over the equivalent period of the previous month. (Source: @redlinkleb/54407)

Israeli airstrikes during the day were recorded in Kfar Tebnit (3), Braashit (2) and Qantara, while artillery shelling hit Mansouri (4), Haddatha (4), Wadi al-Salouqi (3), Khiam (3), Braashit (3), Qantara (2), Zawtar al-Sharqiya (2), Bani Hayyan (2), Wadi al-Hujayr (2), Wadi Zibqin, Zibqin, Kfar Tebnit, Ibl al-Saqi, Rashaf and al-Mari. (Source: @redlinkleb/54408)

Explosions were recorded in Khiam (3), Qantara (3), Mansouri, Haddatha, Zawtar al-Sharqiya, Shihin and Markaba, and machine-gun sweeping in Zawtar al-Sharqiya (8), Haddatha (3), Mazraat Bayt al-Siyad, Braashit, Aita al-Jabal al-Zut and Mansouri. The most UAV-observed villages were Zallaya, Mashghara, Safad al-Battikh, Libbaya and Majdal Selm at four each, with Bint Jbeil (45), Tyre (42) and Nabatieh (36) the most active districts. (Source: @redlinkleb/54408)

Artillery shelling was reported on Wadi al-Hujayr and Haddatha, and separately on Wadi Zibqin, while fire-sweeping operations were reported in Aita al-Jabal al-Zut. (Source: @redlinkleb/54383) (Source: @redlinkleb/54415) (Source: @redlinkleb/54369)

Sounds heard in the Bekaa were attributed to a Lebanese Army training exercise in Jurd al-Akoura, according to a notice issued to distinguish the activity from hostilities. (Source: @redlinkleb/54342)

No message in this dataset reported operational developments, strikes, troop movements or casualty figures in Syria or Iraq. No claims, locations or actors related to either country could be verified from the source material, so no assessment is offered for this section.

Bahrain's Interior Ministry said that following what it termed Iranian aggression, a civilian industrial facility was damaged and a fire broke out at the site. Civil defense forces worked to control the blaze, and according to initial information only property damage was caused with no casualties. (Source: @yediotnews25/138286)

Reports from Bahrain included sirens, additional explosions, and what was described as a likely impact in the heart of a residential neighborhood. Bahrain's Interior Ministry had earlier issued an 'alert of potential threat', and a subsequent update stated that the danger had passed, citing the ministry.
